candidates.source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (MBA) — official site
candidates.why_relevant: The national banking association; publishes announcements (соопштенија), assembly decisions, position statements, ESG/green-finance briefings and sector-level commentary that individual banks do not issue separately. Bilingual mk/en site with a parallel /w/en/ tree.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML crawl of /w/mk/ and /w/en/ section indexes (about-us, activities, nastani); diff against prior snapshot.
queries_used: Македонска банкарска асоцијација членови банки
Banking Association of Macedonia members publications

candidates.source_name: MBA — Members directory (банки, штедилници, институции)
candidates.why_relevant: Single-page enumeration of the entire regulated deposit-taking sector: ~13-14 banks, 2 savings houses (Штедилница Можности, Штедилница ФУЛМ) plus KIBS AD Skopje (clearing/interbank systems) and Македонско кредитно биро. This is the seed actor list for every downstream A1 disclosure crawl.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape member cards (name, HQ address, website) into the actor registry; re-check quarterly for entries/exits (M&A, licence revocations).
queries_used: Banking Association of Macedonia members publications

candidates.source_name: SKIBOR — MBA interbank reference rate portal
candidates.why_relevant: Association-operated benchmark rate portal (Skopje Interbank Offered Rate) with panel/reference-bank list and rate board rules. Both a time-series data source and a pointer identifying which banks are active in the interbank money market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily/weekly fetch of the published rate table plus one-off capture of the reference-bank panel and methodology documents.
queries_used: Македонска банкарска асоцијација членови банки

candidates.source_name: MBA — Собрание и комисии (Assembly and standing commissions)
candidates.why_relevant: Lists MBA's permanent working bodies — payment systems, information security, risk management, liquidity, AML, document processing, securities, HR. The payment-systems and information-security commissions are the exact fora where card/ATM/e-banking/technology-vendor topics surface, and the named delegates map bank-side decision makers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off structured extraction of commission names and named members; re-check annually after assembly sessions.
queries_used: Македонска банкарска асоцијација членови банки

candidates.source_name: MBA — Activities / events / announcements feed
candidates.why_relevant: Rolling stream of association press releases, conference and event materials (ESG and sustainable finance, green economy, European Money Quiz), plus EBF (European Banking Federation) linkage. Event agendas and speaker lists routinely reveal vendor sponsors and bank project owners.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the nastani/activities index pages; capture linked PDFs and agendas.
queries_used: Banking Association of Macedonia members publications

candidates.source_name: MBA — Macroeconomic and banking-system data section (MEDBSRNM)
candidates.why_relevant: Association-curated macroeconomic and banking-system indicators. Useful as a pre-aggregated sector series and as a cross-check against NBRNM statistics; also indicates which indicators the industry itself considers headline.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch page and any linked XLS/PDF releases on a quarterly cadence.
queries_used: Banking Association of Macedonia members publications

candidates.source_name: MBA — MiCreS project newsletter
candidates.why_relevant: Named recurring MBA publication (MiCreS Newsletter, issued in volumes) tied to a credit-related project; recurring serials are high-value because they give a stable, datable disclosure cadence for the association.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the MiCreS sub-index under activities and enumerate newsletter PDF volumes; subscribe if an email list exists.
queries_used: Banking Association of Macedonia members publications

candidates.source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија (Economic Chamber of North Macedonia)
candidates.why_relevant: Oldest and largest business chamber; umbrella for sectoral associations (здруженија), publishes news, regulatory commentary (пропис-инфо), annual activity reports and training programmes including payment-operations (платен промет) trainings. Bilingual mk/en.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the news index (Default.aspx?mId=6&subtype=15&lng=1) and the associations index; note the legacy ASPX query-string URL scheme and session-id (S(...)) paths — normalise URLs before dedup.
queries_used: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија банкарство платежен промет анализа

candidates.source_name: Стопанска комора — Здружение на финансиски организации (Association of Financial Organisations)
candidates.why_relevant: The chamber's sectoral association covering banks, insurers, pension fund managers, non-bank financial companies, leasing firms and savings houses in one body — broader than MBA (which is deposit-takers only). Publishes elected leadership (e.g. presidency drawn from Triglav Osiguruvanje and Tigo Finance), meeting conclusions and sector positions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the association page and its linked news items; extract officer names/companies as actor-map seeds for the non-bank finance segment.
queries_used: mchamber.mk Здружение на банкарството здружение финансии банкарство осигурување Стопанска комора

candidates.source_name: Стопанска комора — annual activity reports (Годишен извештај, PDF archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Chamber annual reports document which sectoral associations met, what positions were adopted and which companies participated — a durable historical record of banking/payments advocacy. The /Upload/Documents/ path is a predictable PDF repository worth enumerating.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest /Upload/Documents/ PDF links discovered via site crawl and search-engine site: queries; index by year.
queries_used: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија банкарство платежен промет анализа

candidates.source_name: MASIT — Стопанска комора за информатички и комуникациски технологии
candidates.why_relevant: The ICT chamber. Its member pages enumerate the technology suppliers that serve banks and payment companies in MK (e.g. ASEE Group, Endava, Interworks, GDi, Insight Group, Finelevate, plus consultancies like EY). This is the single densest local pointer to the bank-technology vendor layer, which A1 disclosure sources rarely name.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the paginated members category (/en/category/members-en/page/N/) and the per-member profile pages (/en/members-en/<slug>/); tag members whose profiles mention banking, fintech, payments, core banking or card systems.
queries_used: MASIT членови ИКТ компании Македонија листа fintech
masit.org.mk members directory Members list companies
local_language_terms_used: Стопанска комора за информатички и комуникациски технологии

candidates.source_name: MASIT legacy site (oldmasit.masit.org.mk) — historical member list
candidates.why_relevant: Archived earlier generation of the MASIT member directory. Comparing old vs current membership reveals vendor entries/exits, renames and acquisitions in the MK ICT-to-banking supplier base over time.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off snapshot plus Wayback Machine backfill; diff against current MASIT membership.
queries_used: masit.org.mk members directory Members list companies

candidates.source_name: Foreign Investors Council (FIC) North Macedonia — White Book & members
candidates.why_relevant: 130+ members from 20 countries explicitly including banking and insurance. The annual White Book is a structured position paper naming regulatory pain points sector by sector — one of the few local documents where foreign-owned banks state policy positions on the record. Also publishes a Business Catalogue (member directory) and press releases.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Navigate the ASPX menu (Projects -> White Book; Members; News & Events -> Press Release) and capture White Book PDFs per edition; URLs are dynamic query-string based so record resolved PDF links, not menu links.
queries_used: Macedonia foreign investors chamber Foreign Investors Council banks members

candidates.source_name: AmCham North Macedonia — members and position papers
candidates.why_relevant: 140+ member companies including several banks (Komercijalna Banka, Stopanska Banka, ProCredit, NLB) per third-party listings. AmCham issues policy positions, committee outputs and event materials; its member directory is a cross-check on which banks are outward-facing on policy.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the members page and the news/position-papers section; low-frequency (quarterly) refresh.
queries_used: Macedonia foreign investors chamber American Chamber of Commerce Macedonia banks members

candidates.source_name: German-Macedonian Business Association (DMWV/МГСЗ) — member directory PDF
candidates.why_relevant: 200+ members; the largest bilateral business association in MK and strategic partner of AHK Nordmazedonien. The annually issued Mitgliederverzeichnis is a downloadable, machine-parsable member directory — an unusually clean pointer artefact. Trilingual context (de/mk/en).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the yearly Mitgliederverzeichnis PDF and parse company table; watch for the next year's filename pattern (DMWV_Mitgliederverzeichnis_YYYY.pdf).

candidates.source_name: AFD — Alternative Financial Services Association of North Macedonia (Асоцијација за алтернативни финансиски услуги)
candidates.why_relevant: Association uniting FinTech companies and non-bank financial service providers operating outside the banking sector in North Macedonia — the counterpart body to MBA for the fintech/consumer-lending segment. Its members and code-of-practice documents are the main pointer to licensed non-bank lenders and payment-adjacent fintechs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Retry fetch from a normal browser user-agent/different resolver; enumerate /en/ and /mk/ member and news sections. Treat the DNS failure as transient, not as evidence the site is dead.
queries_used: Macedonia fintech association Fintech здружение платежни институции Македонија asocijacija
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch returned getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND afd.mk on 2026-08-26; the domain is indexed by search engines with live snippets, so this is treated as a hypothesis (resolver/geo issue), not a dead site.

candidates.source_name: ACI Macedonia — Financial Markets Association
candidates.why_relevant: National chapter of ACI Financial Markets Association: the professional body for bank treasury/FX/money-market dealers. Membership and event materials identify treasury-side practitioners and market conventions, complementing MBA's institution-level view with a practitioner-level one.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of the eng/ and mk/ trees; capture membership and seminar/event pages. Note plain HTTP — check whether HTTPS is available before scheduling.
queries_used: Macedonia fintech association Fintech здружение платежни институции Македонија asocijacija

candidates.source_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија (Macedonian Chambers of Commerce, MCC)
candidates.why_relevant: Second major chamber system (independent of mchamber.mk), described as connecting thousands of member companies to 1000+ national/regional institutions; signs bilateral memoranda (e.g. with the Croatian Chamber) and runs sectoral groupings. A parallel member universe worth diffing against Стопанска комора.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Confirm the live domain (search results surfaced the organisation mainly via its Facebook page facebook.com/www.chamber.mk and Wikipedia); if the website is thin, use the Facebook page as the de-facto announcement channel.

candidates.source_name: Стопанска комора на северо-западна Македонија / Oda Ekonomike e Maqedonisë Veriperëndimore (OEMVP)
candidates.why_relevant: Regional/ethnic-Albanian business chamber (est. 2005, Skopje), publishing in Albanian and Macedonian. Covers a member base — including Albanian-owned SMEs banking with specific institutions — that the Skopje-centric chambers under-represent. Adds the sq language dimension to the MK association landscape.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of /mk/ and /sq/ news sections; keyword filter on banking/payment terms in both languages.

candidates.why_relevant: Specialist local trade publication covering banking and payment cards (dedicated платежни картички category), including e-commerce and cross-border online-payment trends. Frequently reports association and member-bank announcements that never reach English-language media, and is a discovery channel for association events.

candidates.why_relevant: Government-adjacent business-regulation portal that enumerates recognised chambers (комори) with profile pages. A compact way to obtain the authoritative list of chamber-type bodies in MK rather than assembling it ad hoc from search results.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated banking or payments association page was found under the Economic Chamber's finance landing page (mchamber.mk/mk/home/finansii). That page turned out to be a list of donor/IFI financing programmes (GGF, EFSE, EBRD GEFF/ENEF, EIF WB EDIF, KfW, WBIF) rather than a sector association hub.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetched the page; it contained only external finance-programme links, no member lists, analyses or association publications.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents mis-routing the crawler to a dead-end landing page; the correct chamber entry point for this cell is the Здружение на финансиски организации page (zdruzenijainfo/14), not /home/finansii. The IFI links are themselves a separate (out-of-cell) lead.

negative_findings.description: The guessed MASIT members index URL https://masit.org.mk/en/members-en/ returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404 Not Found. Individual member profiles under /en/members-en/<slug>/ do exist, and a paginated category index exists at /en/category/members-en/page/N/ (13+ pages observed via search).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The correct crawl entry point is the paginated category archive, not the bare /members-en/ path. Recording this avoids a wasted crawl branch. This is a moved/absent index, not evidence the directory is gone.

negative_findings.description: afd.mk (Alternative Financial Services Association of North Macedonia) failed to resolve via WebFetch (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) despite appearing in search results with current-looking English and Macedonian content snippets from /en/ and /en/za-nas/.
negative_findings.result_summary: DNS resolution failure on a single attempt; site content is indexed and appears live.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis (resolver, geo-block or transient DNS), NOT a verdict that the site is dead. AFD is the only fintech/non-bank association found for MK and would be a significant coverage loss if wrongly dropped. Must be retried by the verification pass.

negative_findings.description: No publicly downloadable MBA sector report, banking-statistics yearbook or standalone position-paper PDF was located during this pass. Publication evidence was limited to references (MiCreS newsletter volumes, a financial-inclusion brochure and guidelines for banks) surfaced in search snippets rather than direct file URLs.
negative_findings.result_summary: MBA appears to publish mostly as web pages and event material rather than as a numbered PDF report series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations for the collector: MBA should be treated as an HTML-diff source with occasional attachments, not as a PDF-report publisher like a central bank. Deep crawl of /w/mk/nastani/ is needed to find the actual attachment URLs.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) search was executed for association/chamber terms, despite Albanian being a co-official language and OEMVP publishing primarily in Albanian.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian terms such as 'Oda Ekonomike', 'shoqata e bankave', 'anëtarët' were identified but not used as query terms in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Association material aimed at the Albanian-speaking business community (including member lists and event materials) may be entirely missed by mk/en-only querying.

negative_findings.description: The acronym 'СКМ' and the abbreviation 'skm.mk' are ambiguous in Macedonian search: skm.mk resolves to Стоматолошка комора (Dental Chamber), while СКМ is used for Стопанска комора на Македонија. Similarly 'МБА' collides with MBA (the business degree) in mixed mk/en corpora.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both ambiguities produced off-target results during searching.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query construction for this cell must pin acronyms with a disambiguating co-term (e.g. 'МБА' + 'банкарска' or 'банки'; 'СКМ' + 'стопанска') or use full names, otherwise recall/precision degrade badly.

negative_findings.description: Both mchamber.mk and fic.mk run legacy ASP.NET sites with query-string navigation (Default.aspx?mId=&htmlId=&lng=) and, on mchamber, embedded cookie/session tokens in paths (e.g. /(S(2wn2wc45pcvdrzi1cx3slzax))/default.aspx). Two parallel hostnames also coexist: mchamber.mk and mchamber.org.mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Menu links are not stable, statically resolvable URLs; the same content is reachable under multiple host and path forms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive crawler will duplicate content, generate infinite session-id URL variants and fail to build stable document identities. URL normalisation (strip S(...) segments, canonicalise host, key on mId/htmlId/id parameters) is required before scheduling collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) association and chamber sources were not systematically searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass with sq terms: 'Oda Ekonomike e Maqedonisë', 'shoqata bankare', 'anëtarët', 'kumtesë', 'raport vjetor', targeting oemvp.org and Albanian-language business media.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment-specific industry bodies (card scheme national forums, an ATM/POS operators grouping, or a payment institutions association under the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems) were not identified. Only KIBS (as an MBA member institution) surfaced as a payments-infrastructure actor.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search explicitly for 'платежни институции', 'издавачи на електронски пари', 'здружение на платежни институции', and check whether the 2022 payment-services law spawned any self-regulatory body; also profile KIBS AD Skopje (kibs.mk) directly as an infrastructure operator.

coverage_gaps.description: For most association sources the existence of publications is established but the concrete artefact URLs (White Book editions, MiCreS newsletter PDFs, chamber annual reports after 2010, DMWV member directories for other years) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted file-discovery pass using site: and filetype:pdf queries against mba.mk, fic.mk, mchamber.mk/Upload/Documents/, dmwv.mk and masit.org.mk, plus Wayback Machine CDX enumeration for historical editions.

coverage_gaps.description: MASIT's full current membership (13+ pages of paginated profiles) and AmCham's and FIC's member lists were sampled, not enumerated. The bank-technology supplier layer is therefore only partially mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Schedule a one-off exhaustive crawl of masit.org.mk/en/category/members-en/page/1..N, amcham.mk members, and the FIC Business Catalogue; classify each member by whether it serves banking/payments.

coverage_gaps.description: Association event materials (conference agendas, sponsor lists, presentation decks) — historically the richest indirect reveal of vendor-bank relationships — were identified as a category but no concrete deck or agenda repository was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl mba.mk/w/mk/nastani/ and masit.org.mk event pages for attached agendas and sponsor logos; also check MASIT's flagship annual conference site if it is hosted on a separate domain.

coverage_gaps.description: Business Confederation of Macedonia and the European Business Association (both named in a US government listing of principal MK business associations) were surfaced but not investigated; the Сојуз на стопански комори website could not be confirmed live.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and profile these three bodies directly, and use biznisregulativa.mk/Komoris/ as the authoritative index of recognised chambers to ensure none is missed.

brief: North Macedonia's association layer is small, concentrated and unusually pointer-rich: the Macedonian Banking Association (mba.mk, bilingual mk/en) is the authoritative direct source for the deposit-taking sector, exposing in one place the full member roster (13-14 banks, 2 savings houses, KIBS and the Credit Bureau), a commission structure that includes payment systems and information security, the SKIBOR benchmark portal with its reference-bank panel, and a rolling announcements/events stream. Around it sit the chamber system — Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија with its Здружение на финансиски организации (broader than MBA: insurers, leasing, non-bank financial companies), MASIT as the ICT chamber whose paginated member directory is the densest available map of the bank-technology supplier layer, and the foreign-investor bodies (FIC with its annual White Book, AmCham, and the German DMWV whose member directory is published as a parsable PDF). Two segment-specific bodies were found beyond the obvious ones: AFD for non-bank/fintech providers and ACI Macedonia for treasury and financial-markets practitioners. The principal collection caveats are technical rather than legal: mchamber.mk and fic.mk are legacy ASP.NET sites with session-id and query-string URLs requiring normalisation, MBA publishes mostly as HTML rather than as a PDF report series, afd.mk failed DNS on a single attempt and must be retried rather than written off, and no Albanian-language or payment-institution-specific association search has yet been run.
